title: Command Center persistent resource storage across browser, HTTP and desktop
description: Run from the repository root against an isolated authenticated checkout. Set FARMSLOT_UI_URL and FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT for the development browser, FARMSLOT_HTTP_CDP_PORT for the same bundled UI served over plain HTTP from another machine, and FARMSLOT_DESKTOP_CDP_PORT for the desktop app. Only dedicated proof-scope query entries are written or deleted; application data and authentication are unchanged.

proofTargets.claim: A worker starts after first paint, passes all eighteen conformance cases on OPFS, and leaves the database intact while another tab uses memory.
Query bytes and their observation time survive a real page reload.
Deletion from the memory tab seals the owner, drops a late write and leaves the rows absent after reopening.
Plain HTTP from another machine uses memory and visibly warns that data will not survive restart.
The desktop app loads the SQLite WASM worker under its production content security policy.

browser.intent: Exercise OPFS, reload and deletion through the production worker adapter.

browser-proof.intent: Require OPFS conformance and the helper's ownership assertions.

reload-proof.intent: Require stored bytes and age to match after a new document opens the database.

revocation-proof.match: cross-tab revoked; late write dropped; absent after reload
revocation-proof.intent: Require all deletion and late-write assertions through both live tabs.

http.cmd: FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT=${FARMSLOT_HTTP_CDP_PORT:?Select the isolated remote HTTP browser} node apps/command-center/scripts/prove-local-store.mjs http
http.intent: Read the real insecure page's memory fallback and visible notice.

http-proof.intent: Require an insecure context, memory storage and the rendered restart notice.

desktop.cmd: FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT=${FARMSLOT_DESKTOP_CDP_PORT:?Select the isolated desktop app} node apps/command-center/scripts/prove-local-store.mjs desktop
desktop.intent: Read the desktop app's actual WASM-backed database and integrity.

desktop-proof.intent: Require OPFS storage after first paint with SQLite integrity intact.
